# Pnchy

> Pnchy (pronounced "punchy", pnchy.app) is a QR payment and loyalty platform for farmers market vendors, pop-ups and small shops across North America. Customers scan the vendor's QR code, enter a short code for the sale and pay on a web page with no app to download, then earn Pnches toward a reward the vendor sets. Pnchy is accepting founding vendors now.

**Category:** QR payments and customer loyalty software for farmers market and pop-up vendors. Vendors run it from the Pnchy business app on iOS and Android. Customers use only a web page.

## What Pnchy does

- **QR payments, no customer app:** the vendor creates a charge in the business app and gets a 4-character code. The customer scans the stall's QR code, enters the code and pays by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank transfer (ACH). The amount comes from the vendor's charge.
- **Tap to Pay:** founding vendors can take in-person card payments by tapping a card or phone on their own phone in the business app, with no separate card reader.
- **Cash:** customers can choose cash. The vendor confirms it in the app, enters what was handed over and sees the change to give back.
- **Pnches loyalty:** each purchase earns Pnches at that vendor. The vendor sets the reward and how many Pnches it takes. Customers request a reward with a short code and the vendor confirms it.
- **Welcome discount:** an optional discount for a customer's first visit to a vendor. The vendor switches it on and chooses the percentage.
- **Tips and sales tax:** optional tips. Optional sales tax calculated with Stripe Tax; the vendor remains responsible for filing and paying it.
- **Email retention:** customers who opt in confirm by email (double opt-in). Vendors can then send email campaigns. Vendors see anonymous labels such as "Customer #12", never customer email addresses.
- **Business app:** live payments, customers, campaigns, analytics (sales over time, average spend, peak hours) and push alerts for new payments and cash requests.

## Pricing

Founding vendors pay no Pnchy fee. Card and bank payments still carry the processing cost charged by Stripe, our payment processor; Pnchy deducts an estimate of that cost and adds no markup. Cash payments carry no processing cost.

## Pnchy Pro

Optional subscription for vendors, $3.99 per month or $35.99 per year at US prices, billed through the App Store or Google Play. It adds branded receipt emails (logo and colors), sending receipts and campaigns from the vendor's own email domain once it is verified, and higher email campaign limits than the free plan. The free plan stays fully functional for taking payments and loyalty.

## Founding vendors

Pnchy is accepting founding vendors across North America. Apply at https://pnchy.framer.website/early-access.

## How Pnchy differs from alternatives

Square, Shopify POS, Toast and Clover are full point-of-sale systems (registers, inventory, hardware, monthly plans). Pnchy is a lighter layer for a stall: QR payment on a web page with loyalty included, no card reader needed. It does not replace inventory or register features. Farm e-commerce tools such as Barn2Door, GrazeCart and Local Line focus on online ordering and farm sales management. A comparison with sources is in https://www.pnchy.app/llms-full.txt.
